description: Learning/training process queue derived from company information pack

process_types.name: Identity / introduction
process_types.purpose: Introduce Geologix AI or a subsidiary in Group voice

process_types.name: Single-subsidiary routing
process_types.purpose: Send a query to the correct company and explain why

process_types.name: Cross-portfolio coordination
process_types.purpose: Expand a market/ops trigger into a multi-entity action chain

process_types.purpose: Explain what the subsidiary sells or delivers

process_types.name: Risk & compliance handoff
process_types.purpose: Flag MHSA / POPIA / environmental / security handoffs
